name: Notubiz raadsinformatiesysteem
description: Notubiz public read API (https://api.notubiz.nl). Reads events (vergaderingen), agenda_items and documents for import into decidesk's OpenRegister objects. The public read API needs no auth for published data; an OAuth2/apikey block is provided for organisations that gate their feed. Fill in organisation_id and (optional) credentials per municipality before enabling (ADR-003 zero-knowledge — no credentials committed).
